diff_scoping.how: gremlins unleash --diff <branch-or-commit>; files outside the diff are reported SKIPPED (verified). Run from the module root.

report.path: file given by -o <file>; files[].mutations[] = {type,status,line,column}; status is KILLED|LIVED|NOT COVERED|TIMED OUT|NOT VIABLE|SKIPPED; no replacement text

tools.test_command_injection: none: gremlins always runs 'go test'; only --tags, --integration (full suite per mutant) and --coverpkg shape it

tools.probe: { dotnet-stryker --help >/dev/null || dotnet stryker --help >/dev/null; } && { dotnet tool list -g | grep -i dotnet-stryker || dotnet tool list | grep -i dotnet-stryker || true; }

diff_scoping.how: dotnet-stryker --since:<branch|tag|full-or-short-sha>; HEAD~N is rejected, so resolve it with git rev-parse first (verified). Run from the test project directory, or pass --test-project and --solution.

report.path: <output>/reports/mutation-report.json via --reporter json and --output <dir>; files{path}.mutants[] = {id,mutatorName,replacement,status,location}; status is Killed|Survived|NoCoverage|Timeout|Ignored|CompileError

tools.test_command_injection: none: Stryker.NET drives 'dotnet test' itself; narrow with --test-case-filter

tools.install_hint: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @stryker-mutator/core@10.1.1 (or into a temp dir and run its node_modules/.bin/stryker); commit the lockfile so every checkout resolves the same version

diff_scoping.how: No native diff mode. Pass the changed files as mutate: [...] in a config file kept outside the worktree (stryker run <config>), or --mutate a.js,b.js; a file:START-END line range is accepted (verified with mutate).

report.path: jsonReporter.fileName in the config (default reports/mutation/mutation.json); files{path}.mutants[] = {mutatorName,replacement,status,location}; status is Killed|Survived|NoCoverage|Timeout|CompileError|RuntimeError

tools.test_command_injection: config: {"testRunner":"command","commandRunner":{"command":"<cmd>"},"coverageAnalysis":"off"}, or --testRunner command --commandRunner.command "<cmd>" (verified); set tempDirName outside the worktree

tools.probe: mutmut --version || pipx list --short | grep '^mutmut' || python3 -m mutmut --version

diff_scoping.how: No diff mode. mutmut reads only ./pyproject.toml [tool.mutmut] or ./setup.cfg [mutmut] from its cwd, so run it in a copy of the tree under the harden workspace with a generated setup.cfg: source_paths=<pkg dir>, only_mutate=<changed files> (verified). Source must import as a top-level package (a 'src.' module prefix asserts).

report.path: <run dir>/mutants/<pkg>/<module>.py.meta: exit_code_by_key{<mutant key>: 0 survived | non-zero killed or timed out (0 and 1 verified)}; 'mutmut show <key>' prints the mutation diff; 'mutmut export-cicd-stats' writes only counts to mutants/mutmut-cicd-stats.json

tools.test_command_injection: pytest only: extra pytest arguments via pytest_add_cli_args / pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection in the generated config; no arbitrary command

tools.install_hint: brew install maven (JDK required); mvn runs org.pitest:pitest-maven:1.30.1:mutationCoverage; JUnit 5 also needs pitest-junit5-plugin 1.2.2 declared in the pom

diff_scoping.how: No free diff mode (SCM scoping is the paid arcmutate extension). Map changed src/main/java files to fully qualified classes and pass -DtargetClasses=a.B,c.D (verified, Maven). Maven only: projects without a pom.xml are skipped.

report.path: -DoutputFormats=XML -DreportsDirectory=<dir> -DtimestampedReports=false gives <dir>/mutations.xml; <mutation status=KILLED|SURVIVED|NO_COVERAGE|TIMED_OUT> carries sourceFile, mutatedClass, mutatedMethod, lineNumber, mutator, description

tools.test_command_injection: none: PIT runs Maven's configured test framework; narrow with -DtargetTests, -DexcludedClasses, -DexcludedGroups

tools.install_hint: cargo install cargo-mutants --locked --version 26.0.0 (27.x needs rustc 1.88+; 26.0.0 builds on rustc 1.78+)

diff_scoping.how: git diff <base> > <file>; cargo mutants --in-diff <file> (verified: 13 mutants reduced to 7). --file <path> is the target-list fallback.

report.path: <--output dir>/mutants.out/outcomes.json: outcomes[] = {scenario.Mutant{file,function,span,replacement,genre}, summary CaughtMutant|MissedMutant|Unviable|Timeout}; the baseline is a scenario 'Baseline' entry; missed.txt lists survivors

tools.test_command_injection: --cargo-test-arg <arg> (repeatable) and --test-tool cargo|nextest; extra args after -- go to the test binary
